pages.commitMessage:
Merge: God's-Eye Nightly — observation layer for the Mon-Sat pipeline

[skip cd] No files under src/, public/, or astro.config.mjs are touched, so
the deployed site is byte-identical. package.json gains npm scripts, zod,
and playwright only.

Implements raw/strategy/2026-08-05-godseye-PRD.md in full — all 7 steps.
The goal, in Jackson's words: "When you open Claude Code, there is nothing
left to check."

  L0 contracts   readValidated + 14 schemas; a missing key throws naming
                 the file, the key, and a "did you mean" suggestion
  L1 collectors  7 sources incl. GSC URL Inspection (R6); an unhealthy
                 collector reports a reason, never an empty section
  L2 probes      Playwright asserts tags actually FIRE — the June 16 CSP
                 incident hid for a month because gtag.js still loaded 200
  L3 ledger      append-only; no finding may exist without a machine-
                 evaluable closure predicate; regressions detected
  L4 cost        every LLM call priced at write time
  L5 report      one Sonnet call, no truncation, states its own coverage
  L6 dead-man    alarms on ABSENCE, from a separate repo
  L7 corrector   bounded deterministic auto-fixes; no LLM, by design

The headline fix: reconcileInterventions read `raw.pages ?? []` from GSC
history snapshots that have no `pages` key, so it rewrote
data/interventions.jsonl byte-identically for months under a green
checkmark. It now enriches 8 of 8 entries — every one of which was past
its 14-day gate the entire time.

Verified on real data: 7/7 collectors healthy, 100% report coverage, 245
tests passing, architecture lint green, site builds 54 pages unchanged.

Defects found by the system on its first runs, still open: the Friday
workflow failed 2026-07-31 and committed nothing; two pages 404 their own
hero images; 4 URLs are not indexed by Google.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
